# California State University San Marcos

> California State University San Marcos (CSUSM) is a public university providing comprehensive academic programs, library resources, and research databases to support student and faculty scholarship.

CSUSM offers extensive library services including access to academic databases from providers like EbscoHost, ProQuest, Elsevier, and Gale, as well as specialized research tools and course catalogs for current and prospective students.

- [A-Z Databases](https://libguides.csusm.edu/az/databases): Alphabetical directory of academic databases and research tools at CSUSM
